body:
Steps 5–7 of the refactor plan (task:fc9bf315f4eddc7a, notes 6 and 12). This is part 2 of 4 of the module splits, and the hardest one. It waits on task:2414798176c466e4 because the plan moves the types out first.

- **`store_core`:** open, materialize, rewrite, transactions and schema setup.
- **`store_read`:** session, view, inspect, refs, impact and find.
- **`store_write`:** submit, delete, check, test, probe and work.

`Store` has several inherent impls, so name each method (`extract Store::method --to <module>`), not `<Store>`. Keep the existing pattern of an `impl Store` in each module that owns a concern. Make fields `pub(crate)` only where a sibling module needs them, and don't widen the public API.

The rules for every split task are in task:2414798176c466e4.
title: Refactor: split Store
